title: X-Alpha: An AI Quant Researcher with Memory-Driven Self-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2607.08332v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human quantitative researchers mine alpha through an iterative process: they derive hypotheses from financial knowledge, implement and test them as factors, and use the resulting evidence to guide subsequent research. Yet automated alpha mining faces three key bottlenecks: noisy financial knowledge is not directly actionable, exploration can remain confined to similar mechanisms, and feedback may remain tied to individual mining runs. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce X-Alpha, an AI Quant Researcher that couples persistent research memory with continuous hypothesis-to-code discovery. translated_title: X-Alpha：一个具备记忆驱动自我进化能力的AI量化研究员
translated_abstract: 人类量化研究员通过迭代过程挖掘Alpha（超额收益）：他们从金融知识中推导假设，将其实现为因子并进行测试，再利用所得证据指导后续研究。然而，自动化Alpha挖掘面临三个关键瓶颈：嘈杂的金融知识无法直接付诸行动、探索可能局限于相似的机制、反馈可能仅与单次挖掘运行绑定。为解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了X-Alpha，一个将持久研究记忆与持续的“假设到代码”发现相结合的AI量化研究员。报告-记忆抽象机制采用多层过滤与抽象过程，将金融报告转化为可执行、与数据兼容的研究路径。记忆驱动的路由机制利用积累的经验来引导探索方向，并为每个周期定义有针对性的搜索空间。在每个周期内，假设被实现为可执行……
tldr: X-Alpha通过报告-记忆抽象机制将金融报告转化为可执行的研究路径，并利用记忆驱动的路由机制引导探索方向，将持久研究记忆与持续的假设到代码发现相结合，实现了AI量化研究员的记忆驱动自我进化。
en_tdlr: X-Alpha couples persistent research memory with continuous hypothesis-to-code discovery, using Report-to-Memory Abstraction to convert financial reports into actionable research paths and memory-driven routing to guide exploration, thereby achieving memory-driven self-evolution for an AI quant researcher.
